As Bp Plc (BP) Stock Price Declined, Community Trust & Investment Co Lifted by $394,758 Its Holding; Union Bankshares Continues to Hold Stake in Apple (AAPL)
May 13, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Union Bankshares Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 8.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Union Bankshares Corp bought 4,201 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 53,784 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.10M, up from 49,583 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Union Bankshares Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.95B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $188.59. About 25.70 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Community Trust & Investment Co increased its stake in Bp Plc (BP) by 2.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Community Trust & Investment Co bought 9,399 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 360,951 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.17 million, up from 351,552 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Community Trust & Investment Co who had been investing in Bp Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $151.46 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.11% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $45.83. About 3.29 million shares traded. BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) has risen 18.43% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.88% the S&P500.
Among 30 analysts covering BP ( NYSE:BP ), 22 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 73% are positive. BP had 63 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Societe Generale upgraded BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) on Monday, February 12 to “Buy” rating. The firm has “Hold” rating by TheStreet given on Friday, July 24. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, August 29 by Jefferies. The firm has “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank given on Wednesday, July 29. Piper Jaffray upgraded it to “Buy” rating and $4200 target in Friday, August 4 report. The stock has “Outperform” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Monday, September 18. On Wednesday, December 21 the stock rating was upgraded by UBS to “Buy”. Bank of America downgraded the stock to “Underperform” rating in Friday, September 4 report. The stock of BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) has “Neutral” rating given on Wednesday, April 19 by Citigroup. The stock of BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) earned “Reduce” rating by Kepler Cheuvreux on Friday, June 30.

Community Trust & Investment Co, which manages about $800.63 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Cdw Corp (NASDAQ:CDW) by 65,918 shares to 129,416 shares, valued at $8.99 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in American International Group (NYSE:AIG) by 8,775 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 208,572 shares, and cut its stake in General Electric Co (NYSE:GE).
